derivation:
by
  simpa [integerPrime, Ideal.span_singleton_pow, ← natCast_zsmul] using
    (Ideal.primaryComponent_mem (M := G) (integerPrime p).asIdeal x)
explanation: Specialize the membership criterion to ℤ and the ideal (p). Standard simp lemmas reduce torsion by the principal ideal (p^n) to annihilation by p^n and identify integer and natural scalar multiplication.
